Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that “country” meant the modern country of Theodoric’s birthplace and answered “Hungary” without verifying sources or clarifying the intended polity. This misinterpretation (and lack of follow‑up to open and confirm credible sources) led to the wrong solution; the question pertains to his Ostrogothic/Italian realm rather than a modern birthplace.
